# Social indicator: social-indicator (SOCI)

A social or governance statistic of one country over time, with the regional comparison: health, education, inequality, rights and rule of law. One row per social indicator, keyed by INDICATOR_ID. Read by the **world-economy** pack's connector `civic-store` (table `<root>/civic/social-indicator/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/world-economy/samples/social-indicator.jsonl`, 4297 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/world-economy/samples/social-indicator.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `INDICATOR_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INDICATOR_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^SOCI-` | `"SOCI-ABW-EDUCATION-SPEND"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The country and the statistic. | — | `"Aruba · Government expenditure on education"` |
| `INDICATOR` | string | required | The indicator's name as published (Government expenditure on education). | — | `"Government expenditure on education"` |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | string | required | The country's name (Aruba). | — | `"Aruba"` |
| `THEME` | string | required | The theme of the indicator (Society or Governance). | one of `Governance`, `Society` | `"Society"` |
| `LATEST` | number | required | The most recent published value. | — | `3.61856` |
| `LATEST_YEAR` | string | required | The year of the latest value. | — | `"2021"` |
| `UNIT` | string | required | What the value measures. | — | `"% of GDP"` |
| `CHANGE_5Y` | number | optional (filled in 94% of rows) | The latest value minus the value about five years earlier. | — | `-1.8728` |
| `SOURCE_NAME` | string | required | The dataset the series comes from. | one of `UNDP, Human Development Report: composite indices time series`, `World Bank, World Development Indicators`, `World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators` | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `DEFINITION` | string | required | The source's definition of the indicator. | — | `"General government spending on education, as a share of GD…` |
| `SERIES` | array of objects | required | The indicator by year, oldest first, one element per year: YEAR (text) and VALUE in the unit of MEANING.UNIT. | — | [6 objects] |
| `SERIES[].YEAR` | string | required | The calendar year of the value, as four-digit text ("2015"). | — | `"2015"` |
| `SERIES[].VALUE` | number | required | The published value in that year. | — | `5.88827` |
| `BY_REGION` | array of objects | required | The latest value for the countries of the same region, one element per country: COUNTRY (its name) and VALUE. | — | [10 objects] |
| `BY_REGION[].COUNTRY` | string | required | The country, from the same World Bank region. | — | `"Cuba"` |
| `BY_REGION[].VALUE` | number | required | The latest value (2022 or later) for that country. | — | `8.44086` |
| `REGION_NAME` | string | required | The World Bank region of the country, for the regional comparison. | one of `East Asia & Pacific`, `Europe & Central Asia`, `Latin America & Caribbean`, `Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan`, `North America`, `South Asia`, `Sub-Saharan Africa` | `"Latin America & Caribbean"` |
| `JURISDICTION` | string | required | The country: an id of the jurisdiction kind (JUR-<ISO3>). | pattern `^JUR-`; links to `jurisdiction` | `"JUR-ABW"` |

| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The organisation or organisations whose published data this view shows. | one of `UNDP, Human Development Report: composite indices time series`, `World Bank, World Development Indicators`, `World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators` | `"World Bank, World Development Indicators"` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The named dataset and its vintage (the release the numbers come from). | one of `Human Development Index time series (2025 report)`, `World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)`, `Worldwide Governance Indicators (updated 2026-09-25)` | `"World Development Indicators (updated 2026-10-08)"` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data was downloaded by tools/realdata. | — | `"2026-10-10"` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 4,297 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `INDICATOR_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `INDICATOR_ID`, `NAME`, `INDICATOR`, `COUNTRY_NAME`, `THEME`, `LATEST`, `LATEST_YEAR`, `UNIT`, `SOURCE_NAME`, `DEFINITION`, `SERIES`, `BY_REGION`, `REGION_NAME`, `JURISDICTION`, `PROVENANCE`, `MEANING` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `INDICATOR_ID` per snapshot.
- `INDICATOR_ID` matches `^SOCI-`.
